title: hieracium compositum subsp. plecophyllum
intro: Hieracium compositum subsp. plecophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium compositum subsp. plecophyllum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
